text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to apply a small rollout tweak to the payment-service Deployment in staging later today. Goal: reduce spike error rate during rollouts by making pod churn more gradual and avoid HPA thrash.

Alex: Proposed k8s strategy (intent):
```yaml
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxSurge: 1
    maxUnavailable: 0
```
Alex: Also planning to add a brief preStop hook to give connections 10s to drain and bump requests for cpu from 100m -> 150m for the canary pods.

Priya: Quick q — are we changing HPA targets as well or leaving them? Last time we saw scale-up oscillation because CPU target was 50%.

Alex: Good call. Plan is to raise HPA target to 60% and add a stabilization window. Terraform snippet I'll push applies the below HPA patch:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_horizontal_pod_autoscaler" "payment" {
  metadata { name = "payment-hpa" }
  spec {
    max_replicas = 10
    min_replicas = 2
    target_cpu_utilization_percentage = 60
    behavior {
      scale_up { stabilization_window_seconds = 30 }
      scale_down { stabilization_window_seconds = 300 }
    }
  }
}
```

Jamie: +1 on stabilization window. Also suggest we add `podDisruptionBudget` with minAvailable: 2 so k8s doesn't evict too many during node events.

Taylor: nit: when you bump cpu requests, please also set limits to avoid bursting into node reserve. e.g., requests 150m / limits 300m. Otherwise kube-scheduler packs them and we get OOM surprises.

Alex: Good catches — I'll include PDB and limits. Will create a PR with a `terraform plan` link in the thread when ready.

infra-bot: terraform plan for branch alex/rollout-tweak: https://ci.example.com/plans/plan-87321 — shows 4 additions, 2 changes (HPA + Deployment). No drift detected.

Priya: LGTM, can you schedule the canary window around low traffic? say 02:00-03:00 UTC? I'll keep an eye on latency.

Alex: Yup scheduling 02:00 UTC for a 30m canary, then gradual 10% increments. Ping me if you want to join the canary watch: @Jamie @Taylor.

Jamie: I'll be available during that window.

Taylor: same. Also add a quick grafana alert for increase in pod restartCount > 0.5% during rollout.

Alex: Will do. Thanks all.
